LESSON: NAME OF GOD

Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: GOD’S
Topic 1.4: Name of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Name of God. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

You will learn the key ideas about Name of God and use them at home and at school.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

Read about Name of God with your parent or teacher. Say what it means in your own words.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Name of God.
2. Explain Name of God to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
